title: The Kernel Is The Whole Story
summary: A convolution is a sliding weighted average, so its weights are the whole behaviour. Draw a signal, switch kernels, and read blurring, ringing and overshoot straight off the kernel's own spectrum.

sources.title: Oppenheim and Schafer, Discrete-Time Signal Processing, 3rd edition, chapters 2 and 5
Smith, The Scientist and Engineer's Guide to Digital Signal Processing, chapters 6 to 15
Bracewell, The Fourier Transform and Its Applications, 3rd edition, chapter 3
